request.story_prompt: A young girl named Emma discovers an old time machine in an abandoned laboratory. She accidentally travels 100 years into the future and finds a city in danger. Emma must solve a mysterious puzzle, save the city, and return home before the time machine disappears forever.

panels.title: The Hidden Relic
panels.scene_description: Alex, a young girl with messy hair and goggles, discovers an ornate, glowing time machine hidden within the hollow of a massive, ancient tree in an enchanted forest.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, vibrant enchanted forest with glowing flora, a young girl named Alex with goggles and a backpack touching a metallic, steampunk-style time machine embedded in a tree, cinematic lighting, dynamic composition.

panels.title: Leap Through Time
panels.scene_description: The machine activates with a flash of light, pulling Alex forward through a swirling vortex of neon colors and temporal energy.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, Alex inside a swirling vortex of time, motion blur, bright neon blues and purples, expression of shock and wonder, dramatic perspective.

panels.title: The Endangered Future
panels.scene_description: Alex arrives in a futuristic city 100 years ahead, where floating structures are crumbling under a dark, encroaching shadow.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, a breathtaking futuristic city with floating buildings and hover-cars, a dark purple void consuming the skyline, Alex looking up in awe and concern, high contrast, detailed environment.

panels.title: The Puzzle of Light
panels.scene_description: Alex stands before a giant crystalline terminal, holding a glowing artifact from the forest, solving the puzzle to dissipate the shadow.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, close-up of Alex interacting with a glowing holographic puzzle, intense focus, rays of light emitting from the terminal, stylized comic shading, action-oriented.

panels.title: A Hero's Return
panels.scene_description: As the city is saved, the time machine begins to fade into static; Alex leaps back into the portal, barely making it home just as the machine vanishes.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, the futuristic city restored to beauty, Alex leaping into a shimmering portal, the time machine dissolving into pixels and light, dramatic farewell, sense of urgency, bold colors.
